statement: A Democratic member is elected Speaker of the 120th Congress in a House roll call held between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-15.
resolution: True if the Clerk of the House roll call held between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-15 records a Democratic member elected Speaker of the 120th Congress.
failure_condition: No Democratic member has been elected Speaker in a House roll call held between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-15.

statement: Democrats and independents caucusing with them hold at least 51 US Senate seats between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-15.
resolution: True if the Senate.gov party division record shows at least 51 Democrats plus caucusing independents at any point between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-15.
failure_condition: Democrats and caucusing independents hold 50 or fewer Senate seats throughout 2027-01-03 to 2027-01-15.

statement: Russian and Ukrainian delegations attend US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi between 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-20.
resolution: True if Reuters and AP both report Russian and Ukrainian delegations attended US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi held between 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-20.
failure_condition: No US-mediated session attended by both Russian and Ukrainian delegations takes place in Abu Dhabi between 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-20.

statement: Russia and Ukraine both announce a general ceasefire covering the full front line that takes effect between 2026-11-04 and 2027-01-31.
resolution: True if Reuters and AP report both governments announced a general front-wide ceasefire taking effect between 2026-11-04 and 2027-01-31. Local, humanitarian, energy-only, or holiday truces do not count.
failure_condition: No general front-wide ceasefire accepted by both governments takes effect between 2026-11-04 and 2027-01-31.

statement: US forces conduct at least one new strike on Iranian territory between 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: True if CENTCOM or the Pentagon confirms a US strike on Iranian land or islands occurring between 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-30, as reported by Reuters or AP.
failure_condition: No US strike on Iranian land or islands occurs between 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-30.

statement: ICE Brent front-month futures settle above 100.00 dollars per barrel on 2026-12-18. Reference: 103.31 dollars on the packet date.
resolution: True if the ICE Brent front-month settlement on 2026-12-18 is above 100.00 dollars. Reference: 103.31 dollars on 2026-11-03.
failure_condition: The ICE Brent front-month settlement on 2026-12-18 is at or below 100.00 dollars.

statement: The S&P 500 closes above 7,800.00 on 2026-12-31. Reference: 7,586.77 on the packet date.
resolution: True if the FRED SP500 series value for 2026-12-31 is above 7,800.00. Reference: 7,586.77 on 2026-11-03.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 close on 2026-12-31 is at or below 7,800.00.

statement: CISA adds a Siemens IoT2050 vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-11-04 and 2026-12-04.
resolution: True if the CISA KEV catalog carries a Siemens entry naming IoT2050 with a date-added value between 2026-11-04 and 2026-12-04.
failure_condition: No Siemens IoT2050 entry has a KEV date-added value between 2026-11-04 and 2026-12-04.

statement: A European national government or national cyber agency publicly attributes the supermarket refrigeration cyberattacks to a named state or named threat group between 2026-11-04 and 2026-12-15.
resolution: True if Reuters or AP reports such an official attribution to a named state or named group, made between 2026-11-04 and 2026-12-15. Anonymous-source and vendor attributions do not count.
failure_condition: No European national government or national cyber agency makes an on-record attribution to a named state or group between 2026-11-04 and 2026-12-15.

statement: PHIVOLCS raises Mayon Volcano to Alert Level 4 or higher between 2026-11-04 and 2026-12-15.
resolution: True if a PHIVOLCS Mayon bulletin issued between 2026-11-04 and 2026-12-15 raises the volcano to Alert Level 4 or 5.
failure_condition: Mayon is not raised to Alert Level 4 or 5 between 2026-11-04 and 2026-12-15.
